name: Element x Herb Wealth Live Hash Joint | Dubai Runtz x Frogurt
description:
50% Element Live Bubble Hash, 50% top-shelf flower, the Element Live Bubble Hash Joint is certified 100% fire.

This award-winning infused pre-roll adds the power of Element Live Bubble Hash to premium flower, resulting in a solventless joint with percentages higher than 40% above.

This infused joint offering a distinct flavor profile, slow burn, and an impactful punch, appealing to those looking for a unique and true hash encounter.
